lines: Ishq gar ek taraf ho, to saza deta hai
couplets.en: Love is a punishment when it is borne alone.

lines: Aur jab dono taraf ho, to maza deta hai
couplets.en: And when both hearts feel it, love is a pleasure.

lines: Ishq gar ek taraf ho, to saza deta hai
couplets.en: Love is a punishment when it is borne alone.

lines: Apne maathe pe ye bindiya ki chamak rehne do
couplets.en: Let the bindi on your brow keep shining.

lines: Ye sitaara mujhe manzil ka pata deta hai
couplets.en: That star shows me where I am bound.

lines: Aur jab dono taraf ho, to maza deta hai
couplets.en: And when both hearts feel it, love is a pleasure.

lines: Ishq gar ek taraf ho, to saza deta hai
couplets.en: Love is a punishment when it is borne alone.

lines: Ae namak-paash, teri saanwli soorat ki qasam
couplets.en: You who salt my wounds, I swear by your dusky face.

lines: Dil ka har zakhm tujhe dil se dua deta hai
couplets.en: Every wound in my heart blesses you from its depths.

lines: Aur jab dono taraf ho, to maza deta hai
couplets.en: And when both hearts feel it, love is a pleasure.

lines: Ishq gar ek taraf ho, to saza deta hai
couplets.en: Love is a punishment when it is borne alone.

lines: Tum mujhe pyaar se dekho ya na dekho, zaalim
couplets.en: My cruel one, you may look at me with tenderness or withhold it.

lines: Tera andaaz mohabbat ka pata deta hai
couplets.en: Something in your manner gives your love away.

lines: Aur jab dono taraf ho, to maza deta hai
couplets.en: And when both hearts feel it, love is a pleasure.

lines: Ishq gar ek taraf ho, to saza deta hai
couplets.en: Love is a punishment when it is borne alone.

lines: Main kisi jaam ka mohtaaj nahin hoon, Hasrat
couplets.en: I have no need of any cup, Hasrat.

lines: Mera saaqi mujhe aankhon se pila deta hai
couplets.en: My cupbearer gives me wine with a glance.

lines: Aur jab dono taraf ho, to maza deta hai
couplets.en: And when both hearts feel it, love is a pleasure.

lines: Ishq gar ek taraf ho, to saza deta hai
couplets.en: Love is a punishment when it is borne alone.
